$comment: Isolated config for running TS test harnesses under Node + tsx (formerly ts-node esm). Do NOT use CommonJS here: the app's lib chain (src/lib/aiClient.ts) reads import.meta.env at module load, which is undefined-but-safe under ESM and throws under CommonJS. lib must include DOM because the harnesses import the browser-side src/lib sources; vite-env.d.ts provides import.meta.env (vite/client).
